data_transfer_tools.Storage Transfer Service: Managed online S3->GCS transfer; agentless for S3; incremental sync and scheduling.
data_transfer_tools.Transfer Appliance: Offline bulk for very large datasets or constrained bandwidth.

data_transfer_tools.Database Migration Service (CDC): Homogeneous MySQL/PostgreSQL/SQL Server -> Cloud SQL/AlloyDB with continuous replication.
data_transfer_tools.Database Migration Service (Oracle->Post: Heterogeneous Oracle -> AlloyDB/Cloud SQL PG with conversion workspace.
data_transfer_tools.Datastream: Serverless CDC from MySQL/PostgreSQL/Oracle/SQL Server into BigQuery/GCS.
data_transfer_tools.MirrorMaker 2: Kafka topic replication MSK -> Managed Kafka with offset translation.
data_transfer_tools.Dataflow: Custom/large-scale transforms, DynamoDB export conversion, dual-run bridges.
